Allow load_only -> ordered_cycle only for exact old prefix followed by exactly one finite nonnegative strictly descending target.
Keep input.target_mm at the old loading peak. Normalize only path kind/append and the existing four descriptive metadata keys; all other task physics remains exact.
Preserve source task/effective-boundary/state identities and existing nested-child anchor/suffix/index proof checks.
Keep continuation_mode explicit_task_extension and record the task-kind transition as additive continuation metadata.
Existing same-kind load_only append and ordered_cycle extension retain their prior validation paths.
minimal_implementation_design.unchanged_math: Existing ordered_cycle controller already accepts a nonzero saved anchor and signed descent. No force, tangent, KKT, Armijo, bisection, floor, tolerance, or saved_load_only_anchor change is required.

shared_checks: Source nested child is successful and source/ancestor ordinary proofs remain bound; parent files remain byte-identical.

First-unload child legs resume_origin/unloading, correct local/global indices and continuation task_transition; subsequent same-kind child remains usable.

Use existing J positivity, residual tolerance, mean constraint bound and saved settings/options. Do not assert force monotonicity, zero reaction at nonzero endpoint, or a literal actual accepted-state count.
Capture through public evaluate_native for new transition; verify response endpoint and target_response=None, segment/full-path flags and inherited options.
Persistence writes cached 16 force fields, 3 tangent components and original CSC with save F/T0; traps forbid old saved force/tangent/matrix reads and any re-evaluation during save.

method_2_legacy_ordered.checks: Reuse the existing independent ordered_cycle parent -> same-kind append pattern, original peak .0005 unchanged, anchor/index/options/false-full flags preserved.

methods_3_to_7_pure_metadata_or_pre_eval: Cross-kind task mutations: changed old prefix/physics/input peak, more than one appended target, nonfinite/negative/equal/increasing appended endpoint; group literal subcases.
Ineligible source: failed/incomplete, nonterminal selection, selected bisection rather than original target, altered source/effective-boundary task identity.
Broken nested suffix proof: false anchor flags, first anchor state or R mismatch, missing coverage or wrong local/global index.
Public entry rejects absent extend_path/invalid nonboolean extend_path, missing explicit task or zero-start cross-kind request before source decoding/solver; retain old invalid behavior.
Retain same-kind load-only strict increase and low-level saved_load_only_anchor boolean/path-mode restrictions; these are pre-assembly counterexamples, not new numerical runs.

method_8_linear_wrong_R.description: One known linear cold path creates an equilibrated anchor, one descending ordered-cycle warm call with wrong R must fail initial_state_not_equilibrated after exactly one fresh kernel/anchor check, with zero accepted/trials/corrections and unchanged returned state/R.
method_8_linear_wrong_R.rollback_note: Existing test_unaccepted_descending_attempt_rolls_back_revalidated_anchor and split-cycle bisection tests already cover the unchanged controller. Read/retain them; do not add a redundant real FE failure campaign.

resource_recommendation.historical_basis_as_reported_by_parent: Finite CEXT validation: 5 real tiny solves plus 2 linear controller paths, about6.55s. This is a cost basis, not a new timing measurement or convergence guarantee.
resource_recommendation.order: After separate authorization/freeze: install exactly the one reviewed candidate, fresh child finite tests, then one ordinary scalar PNG from saved tiny test records, seal within the same helper window.
resource_recommendation.failure: First error closes the window; retain actual installed source and partial evidence. No automatic rollback, second run, enlarged clock or continuation to real circle.

display_scope.no_new_science: Plot only ordinary recorded scalar values; no field/geometry recomputation or HP.

stage_decision: Implement and validate the small-model interface only in this proposed stage. A real circle1.40 ->1.35 saved continuation must be a separately authorized/frozen card after candidate validation passes.
future_real_stage_budget_basis: Keep the established controller1800/display600/helper2700/outer2760s/8GiB if a real first-unload card is later approved. S5 loading cost is not an unloading convergence guarantee; revalidate its selected saved anchor and retain all genuine accepted intermediates.
qualification_boundary: Small-model compatibility is not circle equilibrium/contact/pressure/clamping/release or HP qualification. A fixed-body actuator unload does not free the workpiece; old CREF1 at1.15 is not transferred to1.40 or a new unloading state.
operations_this_review: Source text reading and external plan writing only; no imports of HF, tests, implementation, arrays/CSV/media reads, hashes, FE/F/T/HP/solver/geometry calls.
minimum_success_gates: All8 finite methods successful, no skipped/error cases; actual method count and all6 real FE solver invocations plus2 linear paths recorded separately.

Each of6 real paths returns success with all declared original targets covered in order; all genuine extra accepted states remain; each saved row passes existing J/residual/constraint gates and cache identity checks.
First native cross-kind child is sourced from already extended load_only child and itself becomes a valid source for subsequent old ordered_cycle append.
Every saved anchor has fresh F/T ordinal1 and one equilibrium check with original state SHA and signed R bytes; new record/response indices and continuation flags are exact.
Parent and ancestor artifacts unchanged, old F/T/matrix never decoded, save_force_calls/save_tangent_calls0, HP/JIT0, no circle/workpiece run.
All negative cases reject at the declared layer; no fallback zero-start, implicit task conversion, relaxed numerical gate or automatic source rollback.
Single plot consumes only new test ordinary JSON scalars, two panels R(d) and relative residual with original tolerance, and explicitly identifies the no-workpiece16cell50DOF fixture.
